title: Nuevas clases sociales
goal: Read how a new urban middle class and working class emerged alongside the old landed oligarchy, and why historians doubt these groups formed as clear an identity as it might seem.

items: Name the two new social groups urban growth produced.
Explain the doubt the text raises about the new middle class's identity.
Describe what São Paulo's coffee boom generated besides wealth for landowners.
Explain who mainly formed the new urban working class.
Use the subjunctive after expressions of doubt like dudo que and no es evidente que.
